data.title: Salad Factory Partners with USDA to Launch "Taste of USA" Campaign
data.description: Salad Factory is partnering with the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the U.S. Embassy in Thailand to launch the "Taste of USA" campaign. The campaign was officially launched by Mr. Piya Dankum , Chief Executive Officer of Green Food Factory Co., Ltd., and Mr. Victorino “Mayo” Floro IV , Regional Agricultural Attaché, USDA/U.S. Embassy Bangkok. It invites Thai consumers to discover the quality and flavors of ingredients from across the United States, including Alaska, through seven dishes developed by the Salad Factory culinary team. Each dish highlights the qualities of its featured ingredient while reflecting the brand's signature style.

data.title: Aura Bangkok Clinic takes T-Beauty global with the world’s 1st airport-based aesthetic clinic
data.description: BANGKOK —Sept 15, 2026 — Aura Wellness Public Co Ltd, the holding company behind Aura Bangkok Clinic, Aura Xpress Clinic and AURASOL, today confirmed that its flagship brand, Aura Bangkok Clinic, has opened the world's first aesthetic clinic to operate beyond immigration inside an international airport departure hall, in the Departure Hall at Suvarnabhumi airport’s Concourse G. For Aura Wellness, the opening marks a milestone in its broader strategy to establish Thailand as the world’s leading beauty and wellness destination, rather than simply one of several options for travellers.

data.title: MiVana Launches Organic Coffee Cherry 'Shot Drink' to Tap Into Wellness Market
data.description: MiVana Company Limited, part of the Premier Group, has launched MiVana SHOT DRINK, a ready-to-drink wellness beverage made from organic coffee cherry pulp sourced from watershed forests in the northern province of Chiang Rai. The launch expands the company’s business beyond organic coffee into the wellness market, with a sales target of 100 million baht in the first 12 months .

data.title: Bangkok Central Kitchen brings healthy meals to 150,000 students
data.description: "Bangkok, City for Better Health" launched a "Central Kitchen" at Wat Don School, enabling the preparation of nutritious meals for almost 1,500 students across seven schools in the Sathon and Bang Rak districts.

data.title: Upper House's First Residences Open for Private Viewing
data.description: The first Upper House Residences are now available to view by private appointment at the Upper House Residences Lounge on Wireless Road, Bangkok.

data.title: IRPC joins force with PTT to provide flood relief supports
data.description: IRPC Public Company Limited (IRPC) led by Sirimeth Leepagorn, Chief Executive Officer and President, in collaboration with PTT Group, handed over relief assistance through the Ministry of Energy to alleviate the suffering of flood victims. The donation was received by Akanat Promphan, Minister of Energy; Chantanon Wannakejohn, Permanent Secretary for Energy; and Sarawut Kaewtathip, Director-General of the Department of Energy Business.

data.title: Islamic finance forum to chart course towards a more sustainable future
data.description: Islamic finance leaders and experts from around the world to exchange perspectives on strengthening economic resilience, mobilising transition finance, and expanding opportunities for international collaboration. The international forum, “Islamic Finance: From Crisis Resilience to Transition Finance”, will be held as an Affiliated Programme in conjunction with the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group, hosted by Thailand. The event is scheduled for Wednesday, Oct 14, at the Grand Ballroom, The Westin Grande Sukhumvit, Bangkok.

data.title: Sea and OpenAI Bring Regional Codex Hackathon Series to Thailand
data.description: Bangkok - Global technology company Sea and OpenAI are bringing the Sea x OpenAI Regional Codex Hackathon Series to Thailand, with the one-day hackathon taking place in Bangkok on 21 November 2026.

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor PLC Wins Two Major Awards at HR Asia Awards 2026
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited , a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , has earned recognition on the Asian stage with two major awards at the HR Asia Awards 2026 . The company received the HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Award - Thailand 2026 for the third consecutive year, as well as the HR Asia People Transformation Awards . The awards reflect its commitment to creating a workplace where employees have opportunities to grow, learn, and continually develop their potential while helping drive sustainable business growth. Miss Nutchanart Arpamongkol , Chief People Officer, and Mr. Kanjanat Chalermjulamanee , Head of Tidlor Academy, accepted the awards on behalf of the company.

data.title: 'STILL : ON' Solo Art Exhibition by Munins Explores the Unstoppable Mind
data.description: River City Bangkok proudly presents “ STILL : ON” , a solo exhibition by Munins that invites viewers to look at the brain as more than just an organ of the human body. It is an essential system that shapes the way we perceive the world, remember experiences, interpret our emotions, and decide how to move forward.

data.title: heygoody.com wins Thailand Technology Excellence Award 2026
data.description: “ heygoody.com ”, a digital insurance brokerage platform operated by Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR), has won the Thailand Technology Excellence Award in the Analytics – Insurance Broker category at the Asian Technology Excellence Awards 2026.

data.title: SCOPE Thonglor sells "Penthouse of Penthouses” for B600m
data.description: SCOPE Thonglor has marked a significant milestone for the Ultra-Luxury Residence market with the sale of its exclusive “Penthouse of Penthouses” Triplex Residence, valued at 600 million baht and spanning over 765 square metres.

data.title: QSNCC, Asean’s first convention centre to receive ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification
data.description: Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre (QSNCC) has received ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for its Information Security Management System (ISMS) becoming the first convention centre in Asean to receive this certification. The achievement reflects QSNCC’s efforts to strengthen its management systems and information technology (IT) infrastructure as well as its approach to data security. It reinforces the centre's readiness to deliver services and support international events, including the 2026 IMF-World Bank Group Annual Meetings taking place this October.

data.title: True Corporation Stands with Thai People, Supporting Flood-Affected Communities
data.description: As continued heavy rainfall and flooding across several areas of Bangkok affect communities with high water levels and travel disruption, True Corporation continues its “True for Thai People” mission, extending assistance, easing the impact on affected communities and standing alongside people throughout the crisis.

data.title: TPC unites 100-plus organisations at AT ONE IMPACT WEEK 2026
data.description: TPC and NO.17 Foundation brought together more than 100 organisations worldwide to announce new strategic collaborations to advance the Well-being Economy, driving change across climate restoration, land, food, ocean, finance, investment and human development. Held in Singapore for its second year, AT ONE IMPACT WEEK 2026 welcomed more than 5,000 participants from across Asia.

data.title: Huawei supports employees during flooding, delivers relief supplies to communities
data.description: Bangkok, September 30, 2026 – Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. announced that, following heavy rainfall and flash flooding across Bangkok from Sept 25-27, 2026, several areas continue to experience high water levels, causing significant disruption to travel. A few Huawei employees have also been affected by the flooding. In response, the company established a dedicated emergency coordination team to provide urgent assistance, including arranging boats and delivering food to employees affected by the situation.

data.title: Central Pattana Wins 3 PropertyGuru Awards, Top Honours for BAAN NINYA KRABI
data.description: Central Pattana’s President & CEO is named Real Estate Personality of the Year 2026, recognising his leadership in the property sector and his vision for drawing on the company’s mixed-use development expertise to create homes, shape cities and enhance quality of life.

data.title: IRPC board appoints Sirimet Leephakorn as CEO
data.description: The IRPC Plc board of directors has appointed Sirimet Leephakorn as the company’s new chief executive officer and president, effective from Oct 1, 2026.

data.title: "Siam Music Yamaha empowers 'Nene Royal' and her 'OZONE' band
data.description: Siam Music Yamaha Co Ltd, Thailand’s leading music business and pioneer music education institution, continues its vital mission to inspire and foster the potential of Thai youth. The company recently announced major support for "Nene Royal" or "Praew-Rattikarn Aumloy," following her monumental achievement in winning a world-class reality talent competition in the United States, along with the members of the youth music band "OZONE," who have played a significant role in inspiring Thai youth to pursue music.

data.title: TCMA and FTI advance Thailand’s industrial transformation
data.description: The Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) and the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) are advancing their strategic collaboration by positioning Saraburi Sandbox as a real-world platform for industrial transformation, bringing together government, the private sector and civil society to translate practical experience into broader industrial action, strengthen competitiveness and support Thailand’s transition toward a low-carbon economy and Net Zero 2050.

data.title: HRH Princess Sirindhorn presides over 12th National Vaccine Conference Awards
data.description: The National Vaccine Institute (NVI) organised the 12th National Vaccine Conference to promote and strengthen the capabilities of the country's vaccine workforce, while fostering networks and collaboration at both individual and organisational levels.
